rejected_in_pilot.reason: 8% faster than byte-pair loads on the 285K P-cores, but needs the stricter sx<w-3 test and gathers are slow on older Intel (post-Downfall microcode) and AMD cores, which were not available to measure
slower than the 128-bit form on every pilot shape (ROI 0.502 vs 0.161 ms)

failures_and_caveats: registered cross-platform gate FAILED: only 9/68 PC reference outputs equal the Mac's in binary64. The difference already exists between fe60159 builds (both references are fe60159/scalar), match counts are equal, scores differ by at most 17 ulps and positions by at most 27 ulps. A Mac fe60159 build with FPM_DISABLE_SIMD and -ffp-contract=off equals the PC in 63/68; the remaining 5 differ in one match's position/corners each, consistent with libm cos/sin. The gate assumed bit-identical cross-platform output from the 12-digit CLI agreement (68/68), which was wrong; same-platform identity (PC 680 runs, Mac 272 runs) passed.
the SSE2 pyrDown removed only 15 of 88 ms in the profile (73 ms remain vs 24 ms on the Mac); the remaining cost is outside the two vectorized loops and was not investigated
most of the gain comes from the SSE2 tier: AVX2+VNNI-INT8 is 6.5% faster than the SSE2 cap and 5.4% faster than the AVX2 cap (geometric means)
one x86 CPU only (Core Ultra 9 285K, Arrow Lake, hybrid). No AMD, no CPU without AVX2, no CPU with AVX2 but without VNNI-INT8 was run; the SSE2 and AVX2 tiers ran only as capped builds on this CPU
on the 285K E-cores the AVX2 grouped product was slower than SSE2 in the pilot; formal timings are pinned to P-cores and do not show E-core behaviour
AVX-VNNI (u8 x s8 vpdpbusd, Alder/Raptor Lake, Zen 5) has no tier; those CPUs use AVX2
the bounded/pruned path's per-window dotProduct is still SSE2 only on x86
GCC and clang on x86-64 were only compiled (Apple clang -arch x86_64 on the Mac, no FMA in the objects); no Linux x86 or GCC build was run
MSVC /fp:contract or /fp:fast would make the scalar loop fuse; the exact-reference test would fail, but there is no compile-time guard for it
the research pipeline, Metal code and GUI are unchanged; the Windows experiments build (33/33) used the new core
preliminary runs (pilot, profiles, run_cli_cases.py) were made before registration on uncommitted trees and are selection evidence only
